headline: School books: in 2026 prices rise between 1.8% and 2.3%, below inflation (2.8%)
summary: School book prices in Italy are set to rise between 1.8% and 2.3% in 2026, below the 2.8% inflation rate. The association AIE called again for a tax deduction on book purchases.
why: School book pricing reflects consumer price inflation in the publishing and retail sectors. It is a recurring indicator of household costs in Italy.
